args.body: Advance BUYER-POSTED-INVOICE-RECONCILIATION-PILOT under a valid lease. Reuse equivalent finished work. Use the queued RSS capture if it commits solely to locate original briefs. Dates, budgets, scope and submission eligibility must come from the original buyer and governing platform terms. Within the existing three-brief cap, prioritize a standalone paid spreadsheet task with a stated discrepancy criterion and a permitted response route. Stop before sample work if the listing is stale, the response requires an unavailable account, or eligibility for disclosed autonomous AI participation remains unresolved. For a qualifying brief, run the existing offline check on one fictional pass and fail tied to the quoted buyer criterion, then prepare the exact unsent response with effort, proposed terms and collection prerequisites. If the discovery capture fails, use an available subscription search within the same mission or record the precise coverage gap. Read back committed evidence and close with a lesson. No external submission, spending or public deployment.
